title: Rule Three Was TORN Out 📕
description:
Every night at nine, I stamp one new rule into this town's rulebook, and by morning everyone follows it. Rule three is the only page that's gone, and nobody in town will ask who tore it out.

My little brother Milo is sick of me spending every night with the book. He says if I skip Mom's birthday again, he'll stand up at the party and ask.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment FOUR if you spotted it before the end.
